_comment: Hand-curated seed catalog. The COMPREHENSIVE set of work-zone (WZDx) feeds
is discovered at runtime from the live USDOT WZDx Feed Registry via
`freetraffic sources discover-wzdx`. This file carries what discovery can't
find: Open511 event feeds, the shared IBI511/Travel-IQ vendor-platform
feeds (one API shape across many states), and live-speed feeds.
Adding a jurisdiction that speaks open511/wzdx/ibi511 is a pure data change.
Feeds with an api_key_env need that environment variable set before they run.
IBI511 URLs on state-branded domains are verified where noted; a few use the
vendor `*.ibi511.com` host or are marked 'verify' -- failures are isolated
per-feed, so an unreachable entry never sinks a run.

feeds.name: 511 SF Bay (MTC) - Open511 Traffic Events
feeds.notes: Reference Open511 deployment. Free token: https://511.org/open-data/token

feeds.name: 511NY - Traffic Speeds
feeds.notes: Live link speeds (the scarce signal). Same key as ibi511-ny-events.

feeds.name: UDOT Traffic (Utah) - Events
feeds.notes: IBI511/Travel-IQ (prod-ut.ibi511.com). Verify base URL on register.

feeds.name: FL511 (Florida) - Events
feeds.notes: IBI511/Travel-IQ. Verify base URL when registering at fl511.com.

feeds.name: New England 511 (NH/ME/VT tri-state) - Events
feeds.notes: Tri-state IBI511/Travel-IQ deployment (NH, ME, VT). Verify base URL.

feeds.name: WSDOT Traveler Information - Traffic Flow (sensor speeds)
feeds.notes: Live-speed feed. Needs a dedicated parser (roadmap): FlowReadingValue per station. Free key: https://wsdot.wa.gov/traffic/api/

feeds.name: Caltrans PeMS - Detector Station Speeds
feeds.notes: Loop-detector speeds/flow. Requires account + custom export parser (roadmap). One of the few true free live-speed sources in the US.
